fusions.name: Crown-Heavy Blow
fusions.desc: A crown-heavy blow that deals 40 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Edict of the Ledge
fusions.desc: Commands the ground to rise under every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 15 damage and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Rank and Rampart
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Unmoved Seat
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that absorbs 30% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
